[rlcd:temperatureMilliC].summary: Reads the onboard temperature in fixed-point milli-degrees.
prerequisites: Import Waveshare RLCD 4.2 and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use RLCD temperature x1000 (C)
examples.explanation: Block notation: Reads the onboard temperature in fixed-point milli-degrees. Integer Celsius times 1000.

notes: For the standalone Waveshare firmware from this repository. Temperature and humidity use integer milli-units. Battery raw readings are uncalibrated. Clock values are UTC (2000..2099); battery retention is unverified. Audio needs a connected speaker. Tone starts asynchronously; wait until audio is not busy between notes. Frequency 50..4000 Hz, duration 1..5000 ms, volume 0..100. Start at volume 10.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32s3_rlcd_4_2\integration\Waveshare_RLCD_4_2.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
